bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; modifying age to angle without a license; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 97A.451, subdivision 8.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 97A.451, subdivision 8, is amended to read:

Subd. 8.
Residents [-90-][+ 65+] years of age or older; fishing.
A resident age [-90-][+ 65+] or older may take fish without a license.
